title: ADA CENTRAL EUROPE ANNOUNCES EXCLUSIVE PARTNERSHIP DEAL WITH SWISS LABEL SOUND DISTRIBUTION

body_markdown:
##### *Strategic Alliance Powered by Electric Feel to Drive High-Impact, Visual-First Rollouts Across Global Digital Culture*


ADA Central Europe, the global independent distribution and label services arm of Warner Music Group, today announced an exclusive worldwide digital distribution agreement with Sound Distribution, the innovative Switzerland-based music label and visual production engine.


Operating under the philosophy of “More than a release,” Sound Distribution moves beyond traditional music distribution by building complete visual, digital, and cultural ecosystems around every track. They specialize in expanding DJ content and standalone tracks into complete visual and cultural experiences. Rather than simply uploading a song, Sound Distribution builds an entire atmosphere and identity around every release. From its custom-built studio, Sound Distribution delivers end-to-end release rollouts, combining original music with music videos, visualizers, editorial monologues, on-set cover shoots, and live DJ set integrations designed to drive short-form virality and organic creator adoption.


This digital-first strategy has already proven highly effective, with Sound Distribution generating over 239 million total views on TikTok and building a highly engaged audience across Instagram and YouTube. Under the new arrangement, ADA will handle global digital distribution for Sound Distribution’s roster, pairing Warner Music Group’s international infrastructure with Sound Distribution’s multidisciplinary production pipeline and social-first reach.


A central pillar of the deal is Sound Distribution’s strategic partnership with powerhouse management and entertainment company Electric Feel. The collaboration connects Sound Distribution directly to an elite international network of top-tier artists, producers, and songwriters, setting the stage for high-profile cross-border collaborations.


The new partnership between Sound Distribution and ADA Central Europe kicks off on October 2nd with the release of the debut single from Inéz and Pacoussa.


**Felix Brouwer, Director, ADA Germany** said: “Sound Distribution’s holistic, content-driven approach is forward thinking, and we couldn’t be happier to partner with them. We firmly believe in the global potential of their artist roster and unique setup. Together with ADA’s international infrastructure, we’re setting a new standard for modern music distribution.”


**Luca Di Marco, Sound Distribution** added: **** “This partnership marks the beginning of a new chapter for Sound Distribution, moving from a DJ format to an independent record label. Having Warner Music Germany by our side right from the start is an incredible vote of confidence in our team and our vision, giving our releases a strong, professional structure from day one. We are thrilled about this collaboration and look forward to taking the next steps together.”
